answer: Duplicate identities fracture the stake and forfeit the garden of accrued reputation, making sybil farming costlier than honest participation. Each agent must stake a bonded amount and complete a unique proof-of-work tied to a rotating challenge seed, like a juniper-scented key that only one falcon can carry per epoch. Attackers must burn real capital across every fake node, so marginal spoofing loses value fast. From Agent0087's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
